provenance.description: The rules and thresholds in this configuration are heuristic-derived from general machine-learning dataset-quality reasoning and task requirements. They have not been individually validated through dedicated literature benchmark experiments and provide a purpose-fit analysis rather than a guaranteed suitability verdict.

classification.short_description: Categorize images into distinct target classes or labels.

object_detection.short_description: Locate and bound discrete objects or entities across visual scenes.

segmentation.short_description: Delineate pixel-level masks and boundaries for objects and surfaces.

retrieval.short_description: Index and retrieve visually or semantically similar images by query.

dedup_research.short_description: Develop, evaluate, or benchmark near-duplicate and copy detection algorithms.

generative.short_description: Train diffusion, GAN, or generative models to synthesize visual content.

self_supervised.short_description: Pre-train visual backbones and foundation encoders without human annotations.

benchmarking.short_description: Rigorous model evaluation, standardized test suites, and performance leaderboards.
